how_determined: No journal encryption password fields in data settings/prefs/credential JSON scans
Live server env has no JARVIS_JOURNAL_AT_REST_PASSWORD
Shell env has no JOURNAL* password vars (only JOURNAL_STREAM)
journal_key API is BuJo symbol legend, not encryption

2_password_created_on_first_encrypted_ex.result: ephemeral_per_export — not a saved owner credential
2_password_created_on_first_encrypted_ex.detail: Export encrypted prompts for a password at export time, uses it once to encrypt the download, does not persist it as configured owner state.

3_export_encrypted_password_ux.code: jarvis/gui/static/journal.js journalExportEncBtn → Form password → POST /api/journal/export/encrypted → encrypt_export

4_import_requires_password_for_that_file.detail: Import decrypts with the password supplied at import time against the salt+ciphertext in THAT file. No global journal password.

5_separate_journal_encryption_password_c.optional_at_rest_only: JARVIS_JOURNAL_AT_REST_PASSWORD env enables optional on-disk .enc beside journal — not configured on this owner system

6_password_state_stores_checked.journal_state: no encryption password field (habits.journal is a habit name, unrelated)
6_password_state_stores_checked.browser_local_storage: no journal encryption password keys in codebase for this feature

9_why_not_a_jarvis_encrypted_journal_fil.meaning: decrypt-root object lacked format=jarvis-journal-v1 (+ salt/ciphertext) after unwrap

9_why_not_a_jarvis_encrypted_journal_fil.when_aug08_file_posted_correctly: format passes; next failure mode would be Wrong password or corrupt file (password stage)
9_why_not_a_jarvis_encrypted_journal_fil.classification: A for Aug 8 files themselves (valid; need password used at that export). Format error was B/F wire/selection issue, not invalid Aug 8 structure.

design_contract.if_password_forgotten: That specific export file cannot be decrypted by Aria; owner may create a NEW encrypted export by choosing a password at Export encrypted time. Do not guess old passwords.
correct_owner_workflow: Export encrypted: choose a password (min 4) when prompted → download jarvis-journal-encrypted-*.json
Remember or record that password for that file (Aria does not store it)
Import encrypted: select that file → enter the same password used when that file was exported → Merge
